prompt: Make a logo reveal under three seconds: draw the circle mark on, then bring in the wordmark, and end holding the full logo for at least half a second.

args.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 100"><circle id="mark" cx="50" cy="50" r="30" fill="none" stroke="#1d3557" stroke-width="6"/><rect id="wordmark" x="100" y="40" width="120" height="20" fill="#1d3557"/></svg>

checks.why: the mark is drawn on before the wordmark arrives

expect.$expr: (() => { const cs = v.shots.flatMap((s) => s.commands); const m = cs.find((c) => c.targets.includes('mark') && (c.type === 'draw' || (c.type === 'enter' && c.style === 'draw'))); const w = cs.find((c) => c.targets.includes('wordmark') && c.type === 'enter'); return !!m && !!w && m.start < w.start; })()

checks.why: under three seconds, ending on a hold of at least half a second

shots.$expr: (() => { const s = v[v.length - 1]; return s.end - Math.max(...s.commands.map((c) => c.end)) >= 500; })()
